attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: original transparent-background front-print artwork for an antique/vintage treasure-hunter T-shirt.
Input 1 is the existing CAR: WRONG Heritage artwork to revise. Input 2 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the shirt with a blue raccoon and rose serif lettering; do not reproduce its animal, wording or distinctive illustration.
Primary request: make the Heritage design markedly more classic and restrained. Preserve the joke and its clear subject: a tagged old wooden cabinet beside a generic tiny hatchback with its rear hatch open, cabinet plainly too large for the car. Keep simple readable forms and no identifiable car make. 
Exact text: upper setup "WIDTH & HEIGHT:" then "PERFECT."; lower payoff "CAR: WRONG." All exact text and punctuation, no added words. Width and height must have equal visual weight in their shared line. PERFECT should not dominate. Lower payoff should be only modestly larger than the setup, with a classic medium-weight narrow Roman serif, elegant bracketed serifs and open counters. No extra-bold slab, balloon font, Cooper Black, outlines, extrusion or drop shadow. Create hierarchy with spacing and placement, not a fat font.
Illustration: render BOTH cabinet and car using a single muted deep slate-blue ink (#3D5960) and transparent negative space. Vintage book-illustration / woodcut character with simplified robust contours, limited broad hatching and ample open areas. No colored fills other than the one blue ink, no gradients, no photographic realism, no microscopic engraving. Include an obvious plain hanging price tag as a blue outline with transparent interior; no tiny tag text. Car should read as a small ordinary anonymous hatchback, not a Mini Cooper.
Typography ink: a single muted warm brick/rose (#985D51), same ink for setup and payoff. Entire image thus uses two flat ink colors plus true transparency, zero white/cream infill. Composition remains open-edged, roughly square/landscape: modest setup above, clear cabinet-and-car narrative centrally, airy payoff below. Avoid sticker border, large ground shape, enclosing badge, extra icons or ornament.
Produce artwork alone on genuine transparent background, not a shirt, no mockup or caption. Sharp high-resolution output suitable for later measured placement.
attempts.assessment: Arched first study; Founder preferred its emblem structure. Payoff too heavy and hatching dense.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create NEW original T-shirt print artwork inspired by the attached reference's quiet classic serif lettering and one-color book illustration. The reference raccoon shirt is for design language only; do not copy its subject, caption, or drawing.
Transparent background, artwork alone, no garment. Two inks: dusty brick/rose type and muted deep slate-blue drawing.
Exact copy: "WIDTH & HEIGHT: PERFECT." above the picture; "CAR: WRONG." below it. Set the top in TWO modest lines, WIDTH & HEIGHT: / PERFECT. Give both setup lines the SAME cap height; do not enlarge PERFECT. Use a REGULAR-WEIGHT BASKERVILLE-like serif with visible thin/thick stroke contrast, elegant slender letterforms, open counters, sharp bracketed serifs. The lower CAR: WRONG. uses the SAME REGULAR-WEIGHT classic type, only 15% taller than setup. Payoff width about 70% of overall illustration width. Absolutely avoid heavy/thick bold slabs or rounded Cooper Black forms. The letters should feel airy and literary, like an old illustrated book title. No outlines, shadows, distressed flecks, or embellishments.
Picture: an oversized antique wooden cabinet with a simple hanging price tag stands beside a tiny ordinary anonymous hatchback seen in three-quarter rear view, rear hatch open. Cabinet visibly far too large for car. Simple refined vintage book drawing, both objects in ONE slate-blue ink with TRANSPARENT interior spaces, sparse broad purposeful hatching and readable contours. Anonymous car without branded features. Cabinet simplified, minimal trim. No microscopic etched details, no gradients, no checkerboard, no filled background. Keep enough separation between contours so objects remain legible on cloth.
Layout: generous open space between top text and objects and below objects before payoff. Illustration is the hero, text restrained. Overall shape close to square. Preserve true clean alpha. High-resolution, crisp edges.
attempts.assessment: Straight stack and fine engraving; not selected.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit the attached CAR: WRONG artwork. Keep its exact wording, slim classic serif letter shapes, muted rose type color, general composition and relative object sizes. Keep the antique cabinet, blank hanging tag and small unbranded open-hatch car. 
Change only the illustration rendering: simplify to a SINGLE muted slate-blue ink drawing with clean broad contours and very sparse hatching. Remove at least 80% of the tiny scratchy hatch marks and speckle texture. Remove ALL white/cream filled areas in the cabinet, car and tag, making those spaces genuinely transparent. Use transparent negative space between blue marks. Keep ample open clear interior spaces and preserve object recognition. No gradients, photographic shading, logo, license plate text or opaque light-colored infill. Car needs only outer contour, hatch opening, two simple wheels, windows and a few body lines; cabinet needs only silhouette, two panels, handles, feet and tag. Artwork remains genuinely transparent, exactly two ink colors in total: blue objects and rose lettering. Do not increase typography weight or change wording.
attempts.assessment: Simpler open linework but straight stack weakened emblem character.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached original CAR: WRONG heritage emblem artwork, preserving its strong arched composition. This is the user's preferred composition. Keep the exact words and punctuation: arched top line "WIDTH & HEIGHT:"; tucked below it "PERFECT."; bottom payoff "CAR: WRONG." Keep the arch, compact broad emblem silhouette, antique cabinet with its decorative curved crown, small hanging sale tag, and anonymous small car with open hatch. Keep the car generic, no logos or recognizable brand trim.

Make two focused refinements:
1. The bottom CAR: WRONG. letters should be a distinctly slimmer classic old-style serif with bracketed serifs, open counters and moderate stroke contrast. Medium weight, not fat slab, not bold balloon, not hairline. Keep enough size for the payoff to read clearly. Let top lettering also feel like classic heritage printing while preserving the arch.
2. Render cabinet and car in a single muted slate-blue ink using broad clean contours, a few solid blue shadow areas and sparse substantial hatching. Remove fine scratches, excessive engraving, tiny trim, dense narrow stripes. Preserve broad negative spaces as genuinely transparent. No opaque white/cream fill. Aim for antique catalogue woodcut charm with print-friendly simplicity, not a technical diagram.

Type is muted terracotta-rose; all illustration is slate blue. Exactly this two-color visual palette with transparent background. No extra graphic, border, garment, background rectangle, checkerboard or mockup. Keep the complete art comfortably inside the canvas and the original wide compact aspect ratio.
attempts.assessment: Selected review draft after Founder requested the arch; remaining cleanup documented.
